'''servant76 Bounty Hunter Cult''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[servant76]]
* '''Published:''' 18 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile servant76 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Court of the Vile Gangster with enhanced bounty hunters and Independent Ships

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

First few turns pull docking bays with the objective.

Set up some characters at the

Docking back and on the sail barge and jabba with 4-lom and either boba or jodo at the audience chamber and then put Mosep at the passenger deck thus you have a drain of 3 and which must come from the reserve. Galid makes it even better.

Get out scum and villany as soon as possible

and augment it's force retrival with first strike.

Ooota Goota is a focal point of this deck.

It turns your bounty hunters into walking

bombs who can draw two battle destiny if

messed with. Desjelic Tatoo + the objective

give most of them forfiet of at least 7. In

the case of obi and quiggy with saber ghhhk

is also a very useful card.

Capturing is secondary to this deck in that

Court is one of the few objectives where

the first side has more benefits than the

second. However if you can get your opponents characters to the barge it can turn into some massive force hurt for your opponent.

The ships in this deck can really lay down

the hurt in space deploy -1 with scum and are defense value and forfiet +1 with desjelic tatoo. They can also be pulled with the objective. Zuckuss and Bossk make a very strong team for only 12 deploy.
